env GOPROXY=off

logos run .
stdout '^generated: 0 5 2$'
stdout '^json: [{]"Value":7,"Count":9[}]$'
stdout '^decode: logos: json: ambiguous unmarshal into union Choice: 2 of 2 members matched'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/out
cd $WORK/out

exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgogenerated

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
typedef unsigned long word;
*/
import "C"

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"iter"
	"logos/arena"
)

type Item[T any] struct { Value T }

func (i Item[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return json.Marshal(i.Value) }
func (i *Item[T]) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error { return json.Unmarshal(data, &i.Value) }

type Choice interface { *Item[C.int] | *Item[C.word] }
type Packet struct { Value Choice; Count *C.int }

func Empty() iter.Seq[C.int] {}

var regionCalls int
var regions [1]arena.Region

func regionIndex() int {
	regionCalls++
	return 0
}

func main() {
	n := 0
	for range Empty() { n++ }
	s := arena.Make[C.int](regions[regionIndex()], 1)
	s[0] = 2
	s = arena.Append(regions[regionIndex()], s, []C.int{3}...)
	fmt.Println("generated:", n, s[0]+s[1], regionCalls)
	count := C.int(9)
	data, err := json.Marshal(Packet{Value: &Item[C.int]{Value: 7}, Count: &count})
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	fmt.Printf("json: %s\n", data)
	zero := C.int(0)
	decoded := Packet{Value: &Item[C.int]{}, Count: &zero}
	err = json.Unmarshal(data, &decoded)
	fmt.Println("decode:", err)
}
